name: Pawmo
description: Pawmo, the Mouse Pokémon, and the evolved form of Pawmi. Able to evolve into Pawmot. An Electric and Fighting type.
pokedex_entries: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
